create_task.description: Create a task on an account for someone on your team, filed under a flow, with a due date and priority.

parameters.description: The account. Pick one, or give its Totango account id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.description: What to do.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: The flow (activity type) to file it under, such as Onboarding.
parameters.name: flow_id

parameters.description: More about the task.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: When the task is due.
parameters.name: due_date

parameters.description: High, normal or low.
parameters.name: priority

parameters.name: assignee

parameters.description: Open or closed.
parameters.name: status

create_touchpoint.description: Log a touchpoint (a call, meeting, email or note) on an account's timeline, with its flow, type and reasons. It is logged as the token's owner unless you name someone else.

parameters.description: The Totango user ids (usually email addresses) of who took part.

description: Work with your Totango customer success data: search accounts and their health, update account and user attributes, track usage, log and manage touchpoints and tasks, run SuccessPlays, and start workflows when accounts, health, touchpoints, tasks or alerts change.

totango_account_health_changed_trigger.description: Runs when an account's health changes, such as from good to poor, with its health now. Health already set when the workflow is turned on doesn't start it.

output.health: Its health now, such as good, average or poor
output.last_activity_time: When its users were last active, in milliseconds since 1970

totango_new_account_trigger.description: Runs when an account (a customer) is added to Totango. Accounts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.last_activity_time: When its users were last active, in milliseconds since 1970

totango_new_alert_trigger.description: Runs when Totango raises an alert on an account. Alerts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.properties: Its details, as Totango gives them
output.timestamp: When it happened, in milliseconds since 1970

parameters.description: The account whose alerts to watch.
parameters.name: account_id

totango_new_task_trigger.description: Runs when a task is added to an account, by a person or a SuccessPlay. Tasks already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.properties: Its details, as Totango gives them
output.timestamp: When it happened, in milliseconds since 1970

parameters.description: The account whose tasks to watch.
parameters.name: account_id

totango_new_touchpoint_trigger.description: Runs when a touchpoint (a call, meeting, email or note) is logged on an account. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.author: Who logged it
output.flow_id: The flow it is filed under
output.subject: Its subject

parameters.description: The account whose touchpoints to watch.
parameters.name: account_id
